privacy: Minimized recurrence classes only; no raw private transcript text, titles, or attachment content.

failure_classes.name: Repeated execution without changed evidence
failure_classes.detection: A work item receives another execution/rerun cycle while source, validation contract, repository state, runner state, evidence and diagnostic hypothesis are materially unchanged.
failure_classes.required_control: Forbid retry until retry_basis names a material change or a genuine blocker is recorded.

failure_classes.name: Repair loop without diagnostic escalation
failure_classes.detection: A second materially related repair occurs without diagnostic_mode, failure classification and falsifiable root-cause hypotheses.
failure_classes.required_control: Second repair requires diagnostic mode and batched root-cause analysis before another final rerun.

failure_classes.name: Unrelated historical validation fan-out
failure_classes.detection: An ordinary current-tranche PR automatically invokes completed historical profiles not required by the tranche acceptance/dependency contract.
failure_classes.required_control: Exactly one changed governed current profile selects the shared Linux/Windows/comparator core by default.

failure_classes.name: Post-merge canonical pointer drift
failure_classes.detection: Application merge succeeds while AIOC still selects the merged/deleted implementation branch as in_progress.
failure_classes.required_control: Treat cross-repository mismatch as repository_state stop-the-line and reconcile before selecting further feature work.

failure_classes.name: Execution interruption becomes owner retry burden
failure_classes.detection: A conversation/runtime interruption ends an execution cycle and the recovery path requires a bare owner Continue merely to rediscover unchanged state.
failure_classes.required_control: Persist exact active operation and convergence counters; recovery must inspect and continue from repository evidence without resetting the cycle.

failure_classes.name: Repeated no-progress cycles
failure_classes.detection: Two execution cycles produce no substantive artifact, narrowed diagnosis, changed blocker, passed required gate, or merge/closeout evidence.
failure_classes.required_control: Escalate to blocked_control_plane, blocked_environment or blocked_owner instead of another generic retry.
